en.headline: Employers in {region} that are struggling to hire
en.subheadline: Every week {firma} gets local employers around {ort} with roles open for 30+ days or several vacancies at once – taken from their own careers pages, with the role and the date we first saw it.

signals.title: Roles open 30+ days
signals.text: A vacancy that stays open for a month is usually the point where a hiring manager is open to agency support.

signals.title: Several roles at once
signals.text: Employers hiring three or more people at the same time often need help with volume or speed.

signals.title: Straight from the source
signals.text: Each lead links to the employer's own careers page, so {firma}'s consultants can call with a specific role in mind.

faq.a: Only companies in the areas you choose – for example {region} – with a fresh, dated event that gives you a reason to get in touch. Each lead is delivered to you once.

faq.q: Where does the data come from?
faq.a: Official company registers, official announcements and companies' own careers pages. We do not use LinkedIn, job boards or other platforms whose terms forbid it.

faq.q: Is there personal data in the leads?
faq.a: No. Company data only: name, address, website, main phone number where published, the event and its source.

faq.q: How does this fit a recruitment agency?
faq.a: Agencies win business by calling at the right moment about a real vacancy. The weekly list gives your consultants that moment for employers in {region}.

faq.q: What does the free sample include?
faq.a: 10 current leads from {region}, with the same fields as the weekly delivery. No obligation, no card required.
